refund.m: Read how replacement, warranty and refunds work at PakAITools. We replace products when the issue is on our side and refund if we cannot replace.
refund.a: Every PakAITools product shows its warranty before you buy. If a problem comes from our side, we replace the product; if we cannot replace it, we refund you. If you break the platform’s rules and the account is banned, no replacement is given.
refund.c:
## Our promise: warranty and terms before you pay
We tell you the warranty, and what happens in case of a problem, before you order. The warranty length for each product is on its product page. If you are unsure, ask on WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) before paying.

## What the warranty covers
- Loss of access or a fault that comes from our side or from our supplier’s side during the warranty period.
- Plans that stop working early without any change made by you.

## Replacement
If the issue comes from our side, we give you a replacement of the same product. The replacement covers the remaining warranty period and the remaining validity of your plan.

## Refund
If we cannot provide a replacement, we refund you. The refund covers the unused part of your plan, based on the terms shown on the product page. Refunds are sent to the payment method you used, where possible. We do not give refunds for a change of mind after a product has been delivered and works as described.

## When replacement or refund does not apply
- You break the platform’s rules or the product rules, and the platform bans or limits the account.
- You change details the product page says must not be changed (for example the email or password on some plans).
- You use more devices than the plan allows, share the product, or misuse the service.
- You leave a workspace or team you were invited to, or remove the plan yourself.
- The warranty period has ended.
- The issue is caused by your device, internet or region settings and not by the plan.

## How to claim
1. Message WhatsApp support (+92 321 9305619) or email support@aitoolspak.com while your warranty is active.
2. Send your order reference and a screenshot or short description of the problem.
3. We check it and give you a replacement or, if that is not possible, a refund.

## Platform risk, in plain words
PakAITools is an independent reseller and is not affiliated with the brands it sells. Platforms can change their terms or features at any time, and some limit account sharing or resale. We explain each product’s rules and warranty before you buy so you can decide with full information.

See also: [Payment Methods](/payment-methods/), [Terms of Service](/terms/), [Contact](/contact/).

If you break the platform’s rules or the product rules (for example changing locked details, using more devices than allowed, or misuse) and the account is banned or limited, there is no replacement.

If we cannot provide a replacement, we refund you. The refund covers the unused part of the plan, as described on the product page.

Message WhatsApp support with your order reference and a screenshot of the problem while your warranty is active.

about.t: About PakAITools – AI Tools & Subscriptions in PKR
about.m: PakAITools makes AI tools and subscriptions affordable in Pakistan with PKR pricing, local payments and clear warranty terms. Founded by Moheez Kiani.
about.a: PakAITools is an independent Pakistani online store that sells AI tools and digital subscriptions in PKR. It was founded by Moheez Kiani to help students, freelancers and businesses in Pakistan use global tools without an international card.
about.c:
## Why we exist
Many of the best AI, design and productivity tools are priced in dollars and need an international card. That is hard for students, freelancers and small businesses in Pakistan. PakAITools exists to remove that barrier with PKR prices, local payment methods and a support team you can reach on WhatsApp.

## What we do
We sell plans for AI assistants, design and video tools, VPNs, streaming, learning apps and developer tools. Each product page lists the price, duration, what you get, the warranty and the rules to follow, so there are no surprises after you pay.

## How we work
- **Transparent:** warranty, replacement and refund terms are shown before you buy.
- **Local:** JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay and UBL, plus Binance for international customers. See [Payment Methods](/payment-methods/).
- **Fast:** orders are delivered within 15 minutes after payment verification.
- **Careful with your accounts:** we do not keep access to your account after a product is delivered, and we ask for passwords only when a plan truly needs them.
- **Independent:** we are an independent reseller and are not affiliated with the brands we sell.

## Founder
PakAITools was founded by **Moheez Kiani**, who runs the store and its customer support.

## Get in touch
WhatsApp +92 321 9305619 · Email support@aitoolspak.com. See the [Contact](/contact/) page.

privacy.m: How PakAITools collects, uses and protects your information when you order AI tools and subscriptions, including what we do with account details.
privacy.a: PakAITools collects only what is needed to deliver your order and support you. We do not keep access to your accounts after delivery, and we do not sell your personal information.
privacy.c:
Last updated: November 22, 2026

## Information we collect
- **Contact details:** your name (if given), WhatsApp number and email.
- **Order details:** the product you bought, price, date and order reference.
- **Payment proof:** receipts or screenshots you send so we can verify payment.
- **Account details for activation:** your account email or invite email and, only where a plan truly needs it, login details you share privately.
- **Website data:** basic technical data such as device type and pages visited, to keep the site working and improve it.

## How we use it
- To deliver your order and give support, replacements or refunds.
- To verify payments and prevent fraud.
- To improve our site and our service.
- To meet legal or accounting duties.

## Your account details
Login details are shared privately and used only to deliver your order. We do not keep access to your accounts after the product has been delivered. We recommend that you change your password after delivery when a product page says so.

## Sharing
We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with payment providers to verify payment, with our suppliers to deliver your order where needed, and with authorities if the law requires it.

## Storage and security
We keep order and support records only as long as needed for warranty, support, accounting and legal reasons. We use reasonable steps to protect your information, but no online system is completely secure.

## Cookies and analytics
The site may use cookies and basic analytics to work properly and understand traffic. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

## Your choices
You can ask us to correct or delete your information, or ask what we hold about you, by messaging WhatsApp +92 321 9305619 or emailing support@aitoolspak.com. We may keep some records where the law or an open warranty requires it.

## Children
Our services are for adults. If you are under 18, please order with a parent or guardian.

## Changes
We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.

## Contact
support@aitoolspak.com · WhatsApp +92 321 9305619. See also our [Terms of Service](/terms/).

blog.title: Canva Pro 1 Month vs 1 Year in Pakistan: Which Plan Costs Less?
blog.desc: Compare the 1-month and 1-year Canva Pro plans in PKR: price, cost per month, warranty and who each plan suits.
blog.ans: Choose the 1-year plan if you design most weeks: it costs {{price:canva-pro-1-year}}, about {{pm:canva-pro-1-year:12}} a month, while twelve 1-month plans would cost {{mul:canva-pro-1-month:12}}. Choose the 1-month plan for a single project or a trial.
blog.src: Plan prices, durations and warranties are read from the PakAITools plan pages. Last reviewed 2026-11-22.
blog.md:
## What are we comparing?
Both plans give you Canva Pro features on your own Canva email through a workspace invitation. No password is needed. The differences are length, price and warranty.

| Plan | Price | Duration | Warranty | Cost per month |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Canva Pro – 1 Month | {{price:canva-pro-1-month}} | 1 month (30 days) | 1-month warranty | {{price:canva-pro-1-month}} |
| Canva Pro – 1 Year | {{price:canva-pro-1-year}} | 12 months | 1-year warranty | about {{pm:canva-pro-1-year:12}} |

## When the 1-month plan makes sense
- You need Canva Pro for one project, an exam, a job application or a trial.
- You are not sure you will keep designing after this month.
- You want the lowest upfront payment: {{price:canva-pro-1-month}}.

## When the 1-year plan makes sense
- You design every week for clients, a shop, a channel or a class.
- Twelve 1-month plans would cost {{mul:canva-pro-1-month:12}}. The yearly plan costs {{price:canva-pro-1-year}}, so it saves {{diff:canva-pro-1-month:12:canva-pro-1-year}}.
- You want one payment and a warranty that lasts the whole year.

## Check these before you order
- Send only your Canva email address. We never ask for your password.
- Do not leave the invited workspace, or Canva Pro features stop working.
- Keep a local backup of important designs.
- Read the [Refund & Warranty Policy](/refund-warranty-policy/) so you know how replacement works.
faq: Per month, yes: about {{pm:canva-pro-1-year:12}} against {{price:canva-pro-1-month}}. It only saves money if you will really use Canva Pro for most of the year.
Do I need to share my Canva password?
No. We send a workspace invitation to your Canva email address and you accept it. We never ask for your Canva password.
What if my access drops during the warranty?
Message WhatsApp support with your order reference while the warranty is active. If the issue is on our side, we restore your access or give a replacement.
Can I start with 1 month and buy the year later?
You can order the yearly plan at any time. If you want advice before paying, message WhatsApp support and tell us how often you design.

blog.title: Adobe Creative Cloud 7 Days vs 4 Months vs 1 Year: Which Plan Fits?
blog.desc: Compare Adobe Creative Cloud 7-day, 4-month and 1-year plans in PKR: price, cost per month, warranty and who each plan suits.
blog.ans: Choose 7 days for one urgent deadline, 4 months for a semester or a quarter of client work, and 1 year if you work in Adobe apps full time. The 1-year plan costs more per month than the 4-month plan; its extra value is a 12-month warranty.
blog.src: Plan prices, durations and warranties are read from the PakAITools plan pages. Last reviewed 2026-11-22.
blog.md:
## The three plans side by side

| Plan | Price | Duration | Warranty | Cost per month |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 7 Days | {{price:adobe-creative-cloud-all-apps-7-days}} | 7 days | 7-day warranty | Not applicable |
| 4 Months + 100GB | {{price:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-4-months}} | 4 months, full expiry date shown | 1-month warranty | about {{pm:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-4-months:4}} |
| 1 Year + 100GB | {{price:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-1-year}} | 12 months, renews monthly | 1-year warranty with replacement or refund for unused days | about {{pm:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-1-year:12}} |

All three work on up to 2 devices.

## Choose 7 days if
- You have one client deadline, a university jury or a short campaign.
- You want to test how the apps run on your laptop.
- Keep the account details unchanged and stay within 2 devices, or the warranty ends.

## Choose 4 months if
- You need Adobe apps for a semester or a quarter of client work.
- You want the expiry date visible from day one.
- You can change the Adobe password after login, but never the account email.

## Choose 1 year if
- You work in Photoshop, Premiere Pro or After Effects most days.
- You want warranty cover for the full 12 months.
- Know this first: the plan renews monthly, so Adobe’s dashboard will not show a 365-day date.

## An honest note on price
The 1-year plan costs more per month than the 4-month plan. What you pay extra for is the 12-month warranty with replacement, or a refund for unused days if no replacement is available, not a lower monthly price. If you only need Adobe for a few months, the 4-month plan is the better value.
faq: Which Adobe plan is the best value per month?
The 4-month plan: about {{pm:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-4-months:4}} a month against about {{pm:adobe-creative-cloud-pro-1-year:12}} for the 1-year plan. The 7-day plan is for one-off needs.
Do I need a credit card?
No. You can pay in PKR with local wallets and bank transfer, and international customers can pay with Binance. See the Payment Methods page.
How many devices can I use?
Each plan works on up to 2 devices. Using more than 2 devices ends the warranty.
Why does the 1-year plan not show a full expiry date?
It renews on a monthly cycle behind the scenes. Your 12 months are covered by our 1-year warranty, with replacement or a refund for unused days if no replacement is available.
